title: Grade 4 CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — Termly Exam #3 (Term 3)

pages.quiz:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #3 (TERM 3)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which is a benefit of obeying parents? (1 mark)
   A. Trouble
   B. Lost trust
   C. Peace at home
   D. Poor marks

2. What is a good way of obeying? (1 mark)
   A. Refuse
   B. Complain
   C. Do it later
   D. Do it at once and cheerfully

3. Which verse says that God is love? (1 mark)
   A. Luke 19:5
   B. Genesis 1:1
   C. Acts 2:38
   D. 1 John 4:8

4. How can we show love for God? (1 mark)
   A. By ignoring them
   B. By being rude
   C. By obeying His teachings
   D. By being greedy

5. Which is school property? (1 mark)
   A. A desk
   B. Your shoes
   C. Your lunch
   D. A pencil case

6. What should you do with a found pencil that is not yours? (1 mark)
   A. Hand it to the teacher
   B. Keep it
   C. Sell it
   D. Throw it away

7. Which of these is harmful to the body? (1 mark)
   A. Vegetables
   B. Alcohol and drugs
   C. Water
   D. Sleep

8. Who does the Bible say we should be like in holiness? (1 mark)
   A. God
   B. Our friends
   C. Our teachers
   D. The king

9. Why did Jesus drive out the buyers and sellers? (1 mark)
   A. They were misusing God's house
   B. They were poor
   C. They were noisy
   D. They were children

10. Why should we take part in church activities? (1 mark)
   A. To show off
   B. To avoid home
   C. To grow spiritually and serve others
   D. To waste time

11. According to Matthew 10:3, which disciple is listed together with Thaddaeus? (1 mark)
   A. Judas Iscariot
   B. James son of Alphaeus
   C. Peter
   D. Andrew

12. Who was Andrew's brother? (1 mark)
   A. John
   B. Simon Peter
   C. Thomas
   D. Philip

13. Which is a group that a child should not join? (1 mark)
   A. A football team with good rules
   B. A church choir
   C. A gang that does wrong
   D. A Bible club

14. Who was watching when Stephen was stoned? (1 mark)
   A. Peter
   B. Thomas
   C. Balaam
   D. A young man named Saul

15. In Matthew 6:5-6, how did Jesus say we should pray? (1 mark)
   A. Loudly to impress
   B. Never
   C. Only in public
   D. Sincerely, not to be seen by others

16. Which verses list the fruit of the Spirit? (1 mark)
   A. Genesis 1:1
   B. Galatians 5:22-23
   C. John 3:16
   D. Luke 1:37

17. Which fruit is shown by making peace between quarrelling friends? (1 mark)
   A. Pride
   B. Laziness
   C. Peace
   D. Greed

18. What does defile mean? (1 mark)
   A. To praise
   B. To make unclean or harm
   C. To help
   D. To clean

19. Who helps us to make right decisions? (1 mark)
   A. The Holy Spirit
   B. Bad friends
   C. Nobody
   D. Strangers

20. Which is a good use of a digital device? (1 mark)
   A. Listening to a gospel song
   B. Spreading rumours
   C. Bullying
   D. Chatting with strangers

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. Give two meanings of the word church. (2 marks)

22. Describe four dangers of misusing social media. (4 marks)

23. Explain why young people should lead holy lives, and give four ways of doing it. (5 marks)

24. List three school rules and give a reason for each. (3 marks)

25. Name two fruits of the Holy Spirit listed in Galatians 5:22-23. (2 marks)

26. List three activities Christians do in church. (3 marks)

27. Explain the two greatest commandments and how a child can obey them. (5 marks)

28. Explain why the body is called a temple of the Holy Spirit. (3 marks)

29. State three reasons why we should pray every day. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #3 (TERM 3) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. C — Peace at home
   Obedience brings harmony.

2. D — Do it at once and cheerfully
   Obey promptly and willingly.

3. D — 1 John 4:8
   1 John 4:8 states that God is love.

4. C — By obeying His teachings
   Jesus said love shows in obedience.

5. A — A desk
   A desk belongs to the school.

6. A — Hand it to the teacher
   Return what is not yours.

7. B — Alcohol and drugs
   Drugs and alcohol harm the body.

8. A — God
   1 Peter 1:16 says to be holy because God is holy.

9. A — They were misusing God's house
   The temple was for prayer, not trading.

10. C — To grow spiritually and serve others
   Participation helps faith to grow.

11. B — James son of Alphaeus
   Matthew 10:3 pairs James son of Alphaeus with Thaddaeus.

12. B — Simon Peter
   Simon Peter and Andrew were brothers.

13. C — A gang that does wrong
   Ungodly groups lead to harm.

14. D — A young man named Saul
   Acts 7:58.

15. D — Sincerely, not to be seen by others
   Jesus warned against showing off.

16. B — Galatians 5:22-23
   Galatians 5:22-23.

17. C — Peace
   Peace is a fruit.

18. B — To make unclean or harm
   Defile means to harm or make unclean.

19. A — The Holy Spirit
   The Spirit guides believers.

20. A — Listening to a gospel song
   Gospel songs are uplifting.

SECTION B
----
21. (2 marks)
   Answer: The building where Christians worship; the community of believers.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

22. (4 marks)
   Answer: Strangers, harmful content, bullying, too much screen time, rumours, sharing private details.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each danger up to 4.

23. (5 marks)
   Answer: God is holy and asks us to be holy. Our bodies are temples of the Holy Spirit. A holy life keeps us safe and pleases God. Ways: keep clean, avoid drugs and alcohol, choose good friends, avoid harmful media, pray and read the Bible.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for God's call, 1 for the temple idea, 1 for safety, 2 for ways.

24. (3 marks)
   Answer: Arrive on time, so lessons are not disturbed; keep quiet in class, so all can learn; do not fight, so all are safe.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each rule with a reason.

25. (2 marks)
   Answer: Any two of love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faithfulness, gentleness, self-control.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct fruit.

26. (3 marks)
   Answer: Pray, sing, read the Bible, give offerings, listen to the sermon, fellowship.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

27. (5 marks)
   Answer: Love God with all your heart, soul and mind, and love your neighbour as yourself. A child obeys by praying, reading the Bible, going to church, and by kindness, sharing and forgiving others.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for loving God, 1 for loving neighbour, 1 for prayer or Bible, 1 for kindness, 1 for forgiving or sharing.

28. (3 marks)
   Answer: The Holy Spirit lives in believers, so the body is holy like a temple and should be treated with respect.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for Holy Spirit, 1 for holy, 1 for respect.

29. (3 marks)
   Answer: We can thank God; ask for help; grow spiritually; know God better; get strength to avoid wrong.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each reason.
